changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 3 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6310-designer-formula-key-retired.md`

- names `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` — edited by this change

  > Not touched: `designer.field.formula` (`'Formula (CEL)'`) in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, a different and live key belonging to metadata-admin's `ObjectFieldInspector` — the surface that still authors formula expressions.

### `.changeset/7125-dashboard-empty-state-keys-retired.md`

- names `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` — edited by this change

  > Not touched: `table.noRows` (`'No rows to display'`) and `engine.form.noRows` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, read at `widgets.tsx`) — two different, same-named keys in different namespaces. Nor the comments in `WidgetEmptyState.tsx`, `DatasetWidget.tsx`, `ObjectDataTable.tsx` and `PivotTable.tsx` that record WHY three widgets with three strings became one shared empty state; the packs' own comment keeps that rationale and now names the retirement instead of a row that is gone.

### `.changeset/8632-malformed-picklist-option-loud.md`

- names `views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` — edited by this change

  > Two new strings land in the designer's own `en` / `zh` tables — the metadata-admin console owns its strings in `views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` and is deliberately outside the ten locale packs (`packages/i18n/README.md`, "Scope — the `engine.*` carve-out").

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `c6678b1bd` (merge-base with origin/main): 17 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1649 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2240 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36369416765)

## Contract review

Served-tier: 221/221 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `5cac47f693d22ad38261c53111f7b5e167844d6b`

Read: card objectui#10862 body and thread (triage `5860733428`, slice-1 ACCEPT `5861649175`, slice-2 claim `5861770181`; the dev report `5862166830` was not used as evidence); PR #10880 body, file list (18 files) and the full diff `309d17b..5cac47f` (merge-base with `origin/main` is `309d17b`, slice 1's merge; main has since taken `c6678b1`, `de1b879`, `b93e245`, none touching a PR file); head sources of `celAuthoring.ts`, `CelPredicateField.tsx`, `clientValidation.ts`, `i18n.ts`, `previews/row-nodes.ts`, `previews/PreviewShell.tsx`, `previews/index.ts`, `preview-registry.ts`, the seven previews, the four hosts of `CelPredicateField` and their parents (`PermissionMatrixEditor`, `ViewVariantInspector`), the three registry hosts (`ResourceEditPage`, `EmbeddedItemEditor`, `StudioDesignSurface`), `external/ExternalDatasourcePanel.tsx`; the two new pin files and the four rewritten tests; a `vi.mock` census over `packages/` and `apps/` at the head (120 sites); objectui `AGENTS.md` §5 and §9 (changeset presence, 测试纪律, 版本号策略); `.changeset/config.json`, the PR's changeset and every pending changeset naming a touched file; the family PRs #10832, #10850, #10857 and #10871 (file lists, and #10871's two commits `d9346a0` then `aa8601e`); the head's check-runs twice; one local run of the two pins plus the skew test in a throwaway worktree (removed).

### ① Derived judgments

1. The slice-1 lesson — RIGHT. `celAuthoring.ts` at the head has no static `import` and no `export … from`; its only loads are three dynamic `import()` calls (`@objectstack/formula` in the formula loader, `@objectstack/lint` in the field-rule loader, `@object-ui/core` in the row-canon loader). New static edges at the head: the seven previews to `../i18n.js` (each already reached that module at base through `./PreviewShell.js`, whose base imports are `react`, `lucide-react` and `../i18n.js`); `AppPreview`, `BookPreview`, `EmailTemplatePreview` and `PositionPreview` to `./row-nodes.js` (a 19-line module importing `react` only); `celAuthoring.test.ts` and `celAuthoring.fieldRuleVerdict-9318.test.ts` to `./i18n` (neither file calls `vi.mock`). `CelPredicateField.tsx` keeps its base imports. Census of full-replacement mocks: `@objectstack/spec/ui` has one (`clientValidation.skew.test.tsx`, whose closure runs `clientValidation.ts` → `celAuthoring.ts`, both blobs byte-identical base and head: `a426c0b…` and `8b56926…`); `@object-ui/core` has one full replacement (`plugin-report/src/__tests__/ReportRenderer.test.tsx`, no app-shell dependency) and two `importOriginal`; `@object-ui/i18n` has 109 sites, 104 `importOriginal` and five full replacements (console/cloud-connection ×2, console/organizations, layout, preview), none importing a metadata-admin module; the designer `./i18n` has seven, all `importOriginal`. No closure grows through any of them. The skew test is untouched and green: CI's eight shards are green, and the local run of the three files reports `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 48 passed (48)` (38 + 6 + 4), `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

2. The advisory seam — RIGHT. `CelLintIssue` is a three-way union: an error with `message: string`, a warning with `message: string`, and a warning with `messageKey: CelLintMessageKey` plus `messageVars: Record‹string, string›` and `message?: never`; `CelLintMessageKey` is exactly `engine.celLint.notTheRow` | `engine.celLint.notPushdownable`. `rowCanonAdvisory` returns the keyed warning with `identifier` / `canonical`; the `USING` pushdown branch pushes the keyed warning with `detail: pd.detail`. The `@objectstack/lint` branch, the engine parse and field errors and the engine's detail are untouched and pass through as written (the CEL pin's producer control finds `fieldRuleRootIssue('visibleWhen', …).message` on the real field). Can a consumer read a key as text: the keyed variant types `message` as `never`, so `.message` on an un-narrowed issue is `string | undefined` and a consumer that renders it unnarrowed fails `tsc`; every consumer at the head narrows on `severity === 'error'` first — `clientValidation.ts` at its three call sites (`if (f.severity !== 'error') continue;` then `f.message`), the `onLintChange` handlers in `PermissionAdvancedFacets`, `ConditionalFormattingEditor`, `ConditionBuilder` and `ObjectFieldInspector` (each counts errors only), and the three `ConditionBuilder.*mountRoots|contextSubjects` tests (filter errors, then `.message`). So no keyed advisory reaches `clientValidation`'s output, by type and by code. `CelPredicateField.issueText` renders both the errors list and the warnings list through it: producer message as written, or `t(iss.messageKey)` with holes filled by the same regex `tFormat` uses (an unfilled hole stays as written in both). The host-bound `t` chain: `ConditionBuilder` `tLocal = t(k, locale)` with `locale = useMetadataLocale()`; `PermissionMatrixEditor` `t = translate(k, locale)` with `useMetadataLocale()` handed to `PermissionAdvancedFacets` `t={t}` and on to both fields; `ObjectFieldInspector` `tr = t(key, locale)` from its `locale` prop at all four field sites; `ViewVariantInspector` `tLocal` → `ConditionalFormattingEditor` `t={tLocal}` → the field. Tests that read advisory text: the two `celAuthoring` tests read `en(i)` = `tFormat(messageKey, 'en-US', vars)`, so every regex still checks English words; `CelPredicateField.test.tsx` and `ConditionalFormattingEditor.test.tsx` mount with an identity `t` (`k ↦ k`) and now expect the key, which is what their harness shows for `perm.cel.valid` too — no user sees that harness, and the user-visible text is pinned by the new CEL pin against the real `t`.

3. Rows — RIGHT. Parsed from the diff's two hunks (`ENGINE_STRINGS_EN` at 1444, `ENGINE_STRINGS_ZH` at 4041): 106 en rows and 106 zh rows, equal key sets, identical placeholder sets per key, every zh row contains CJK, no en row equals its zh row. All 106 en rows were compared with the literal each replaced in the seven preview diffs and `celAuthoring.ts`, not a sample: App 8 (`Open this app in a new tab`, `Open`, `Home: opens the first navigation item`, `Home: no navigation item yields a route yet`, the nav empty sentence, `(unnamed)`, the `type` discriminator tooltip, `no type`); Position 4 (`Give the position a name to see the preview.`, `Positions don't grant data access on their own.`, the bind sentence, `Permission Sets`); Datasource 10 (`Set a name and at least a driver…`, `unknown`, `Active`, `Disabled`, `Connection`, `No config keys set.`, `redacted`, `Pool`, `not configured`, the key-count row); Email 9 (`Fill in the subject / body…`, `(empty body)`, `From`, `To`, `Subject`, `Email preview`, `Variables`, `No {var} placeholders found.`, `sample for {name}`); Book 22 (`Name your book` through `(empty)`, including `Permission set: {name}`, `Slug: {slug}`, `Order within the book`, `Membership rule is scoped to this package`, `Curated order via explicit pages`, `Glob over doc names`, `Match by doc tag`, `…rest (remaining matched docs, by order)`); Permission 37 (the empty prompt, both kinds, four count pills, four section titles, `Object`, eight capability tooltips, `Read / write access depth (ADR-0057)`, `Scope`, `Read scope`, `Write scope`, `default`, `hidden`, `editable`, the two sanity-count rows, four warnings including `Write scope ({write}) is wider than read scope ({read}) — edits may target invisible records.`, `granted`, `not granted`, `bypass (View/Modify All)`, the legend key line); Translation 14 (the empty prompt, eight category names, `Category coverage:`, `{count} total keys`, `empty`, `+{count} more…`, the key-count row); the two advisories byte-equal to the template strings removed from `celAuthoring.ts` with `${…}` become `{identifier}` / `{canonical}` / `{detail}`. Two rows fold JSX whitespace (the position bind sentence, the book no-groups description): the row equals the text JSX rendered. The key-count rows for datasource and translation wrap `{count} keys` in one pair of literal braces, as the base template literal did. `withNodes` holes — `{navigation}`, `{slug}`, `{groups}` `{include}` `{glob}` `{tag}`, `{include}` `{pages}` `{group}`, `{var}`, `{name}` `{permissionSets}` — are filled with the same code span text the base rendered, sentence order kept; the admin pin reads each such row with the hole filled and finds it on the mount in both languages.

4. Census and exclusions — RIGHT. A script census over the seven head files (JSX text nodes; `title`, `aria-label`, `placeholder`, `label`, `hint` attributes; `label:` / `message:` / `title:` table values) leaves: `hint=` props (`PreviewShell`'s `hint` is declared "No longer rendered"); code-span identifiers (`navigation`, `groups`, `include`, `pages`, `crm_guide_*`); `title="SSL"`; the field-security tooltip `readable=… editable=…` (the spec's `FieldPermission` key names with booleans); the tab-visibility enum value `{vis}`; the compacted `SCOPE_LABEL` tokens; the C / R / U / D / E / T / V* / M* letters, with the legend key row now localized; notation `#{order}`, `∅`, `[N]`, `••••••`, `{populated}/{n} ({coverage}%)`. `BookPreview.normalizeGroups`' `(unnamed)` is unreachable (`if (!key && !label) return null;` precedes `label || key || '(unnamed)'`); `AppPreview`'s own `(unnamed)` was reachable and is localized. `external/ExternalDatasourcePanel.tsx` is not in the PR's file list, reads no designer `t`, and carries `Federation is not enabled on this server.`, `Refresh catalog` and the `Tables` / `Validation` tab labels: outside the seven-file census, for the seat to carry.

5. Files beyond the claim — RIGHT. `previews/row-nodes.ts` is the same function `ActionPreview` keeps locally (split on `{token}`, fragment per part, `createElement` in place of JSX), imports `react` only, is reached by four previews, and is named in the PR body. The four test edits: the two `celAuthoring` tests keep every assertion and apply it to `en(i)`; the two component tests move from a text regex to the key their identity `t` shows; the PR body's Tests section names all four and why.
